We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the statute of limitations for Account ID ACC-235215. We understand your concern about ensuring the accuracy of your credit report, as required by the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) 605B.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and the Texas Debt Collection Act, we must investigate your dispute. We will review the account history, including the charge-off date of November 3, 2021, to determine if the statute of limitations has expired.

Our records indicate that the current balance for this account is $9,048.33. We will investigate this matter further and respond to you with our findings. If we determine that the statute of limitations has expired, we will take the necessary steps to update our records accordingly.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this matter further if you are not satisfied with our response. We will provide you with a written validation of the debt, as required by the FDCPA, if our investigation confirms that the debt is valid.
